method.method_draft: Read the figure as triangle ABC inscribed in circle O, with O the center and OB, OC drawn. Add the auxiliary radius OA. Let ∠BAO = x and ∠OAC = y, so x + y = ∠A = 40°. Since OA = OB, triangle AOB is isosceles, so ∠ABO = x and ∠AOB = 180° − 2x. Since OA = OC, triangle AOC is isosceles, so ∠ACO = y and ∠AOC = 180° − 2y. Around point O, the angles ∠AOB, ∠BOC, and ∠COA sum to 360°, so ∠BOC = 360° − (180° − 2x) − (180° − 2y) = 2x + 2y = 2(x+y) = 80°.
